$comment: Expected gallery and film counts, in one place. Adding, merging or removing an effect, variant, basic or film changes these on purpose: update the numbers here and say why in the commit. Filters name the gallery buttons; families and basics count visible cards, demos and variants count the matching entries. This revision adds 16 distinct effect families, 10 variants, 2 flagship 60fps demo films (stroke-mural, liquid-chrome-type), promotes mechanical/ink-city/fight-effects into Demo films, moves water-forms to Use cases, and retires the 3 redundant sampler films.

films.$cards: Film cards on the home page by section, in page order: the featured cards, then the smaller cards (listed films that are not a version of another film).
